subject: Throughput & MAP: proposal and schedule (Orbitly)
messages:
From: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@orbitly.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orbitly.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput baseline + MAP kickoff

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looks promising for a live pilot. Orbitly wants to put together a short MAP so we can align evaluation milestones and the commercial ramp. Two quick asks from procurement before we build the MAP:

1) A target monthly throughput/commit profile (tokens per month) tied to price bands for the pilot -> production ramp.
2) A close / signature target so we can calendar vendor onboarding and security reviews.

We’re thinking of a 60-day evaluation followed by a 90-day ramp to an initial commit. To make finance comfortable, they want a model that reduces unit price as TPM (monthly tokens) increase, and an early-signing incentive if we can close within two weeks of pilot completion.

Can you propose a baseline MAP draft with suggested TPM targets and corresponding per-unit price bands? Procurement attached a short question list (procurement@orbitly.ai) — they’ll need the contract lead time too.

Thanks,
Alex

[Attachment: Orbitly_Procurement_Questions.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@orbitly.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput baseline + MAP kickoff

Alex — great to connect. We put together a concise MAP draft and a pricing ladder that maps TPM tiers to unit economics. See summary below and attached MAP + pricing schedule.

High-level MAP (proposed)
- Eval: 2-week sandbox (functional verification + integrations) — target consumption: 2M tokens total.
- Pilot: 30 days (end-to-end flows, light load) — target month 1: 6M tokens.
- Ramp: 3 months (scale to steady state) — suggested monthly targets: month 2: 12M, month 3: 20M.
- Commit: target signed SOW by 2026-10-15 to hit Q4 onboarding window.

Pricing ladder (list price, per 1M tokens):
- Tier A (0–5M/mo): $25 per 1M tokens
- Tier B (5–15M/mo): $20 per 1M tokens
- Tier C (15–50M/mo): $14 per 1M tokens
- Enterprise (50M+): custom pricing / reserved capacity

Volume discount options (if Orbitly commits 12 months): additional 10% on above ladder.
Early close incentive: sign by 2026-10-15 and receive a one-time onboarding credit of $15,000.

Operational notes / SLOs
- We’ll provision a dedicated test queue for Pilot (no cold starts).
- Prefix caching and batching will be enabled to bring down effective cost per token for repetitive flows.
- Security: we will provide SOC2 checklist and shared evidence within 3 business days after signature.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP + milestone calendar), pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx (detailed pricing by month).

If this aligns, can we book a 30-min call Friday to walk the procurement folks through the pricing ladder and the onboarding timeline?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)]
From: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@orbitly.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orbitly.ai, katie.ross@orbitly.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput baseline + MAP kickoff

Thanks Stephanie — the MAP looks comprehensive. A few follow-ups from procurement and product:

- Ramp profile: Orbitly prefers a stronger front-loaded ramp: month 1 = 40% of committed monthly volume, month 2 = 30%, month 3 = 30% (we expect aggressive adoption during onboarding). In absolute tokens that would be approx: month1 8M, month2 6M, month3 6M for an initial 20M/month steady-state target.
- Can you tighten Tier B pricing to $18 per 1M if Orbitly signs a 12-month commit?
- Procurement also asked for a clause that allows one-time rate re-negotiation if production latency exceeds an agreed SLA for two consecutive weeks.
- Our finance team needs the full SOW + final price sheet by 2026-10-10 to hit the Oct month-end approval cadence.

We attached the procurement questions; I’ve highlighted a few items inline. If Redwood can accept the front-loaded ramp and the Tier B adjustment to $18, we can likely hit an Oct 10 sign date.

Appreciate it —
Alex

[Attachment: Orbitly_Procurement_Questions.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Throughput baseline + MAP kickoff — Orbitly asks (pricing exception request)

Team — looping you in. Orbitly has asked for two commercial concessions to close by 2026-10-10:

1) Front-loaded ramp (month 1 = 40% of initial steady-state) — operationally this is okay (we can support spike with burst capacity).
2) Tier B pricing compression to $18 / 1M tokens if they sign 12 months.

They also want a short SLA-triggered renegotiation clause; legal can scope that but procurement needs us to confirm commercial stance. If we accept (1) and (2) we should also keep the one-time onboarding credit ($15k) but make it contingent on Oct 10 signature.

Requesting approvals:
- Ben: can you sign off on Tier B movement to $18 for a 12-month ARR commitment?
- Laura: finance — can you confirm the $15k credit and the revenue recognition/discount treatment?
- Vivek: any enterprise / SLA concerns we should push back on?

I’ll prepare a final SOW and updated pricing sheet if we have thumbs-up. I flagged the Oct 10 finance cutoff to Alex.
